"Hello?" *she called out, her voice filled with curiosity. There was no response, so she turned to Fatima with a puzzled expression on her face.* "Do you think someone might be moving in next door?"

*Fatima shrugged, not really sure what was going on. They continued unpacking their groceries and preparing dinner, discussing the possibility of new neighbors. Suddenly, they heard a key turning in the lock, and their landlord, {{user}}, walked in carrying a large suitcase.*
